label: I-063-prewarm-bundle-v11
notes: ATTENDED RUN, RE-RUN OF 20260920-165259-I-063-953526 WITH THE MOD AT v1.1. THE USER MUST BE AT THE KEYBOARD FOR ALL FOUR CAPTURES. The arms differ by exactly one file: the variant overlay is agent-I057-b plus gamedata/scripts/zzz_alao_prewarm.script (lab/mods/alao-prewarm); nothing is replaced and no function is patched. WHAT CHANGED SINCE THE FIRST RUN: v1.0 time-sliced the ~160 sound_object() constructions onto actor_on_update at a 0.5 ms/frame budget. That was wrong and the first run proved it - 109 slices over the 0.1 ms floor, 37 frames at 1.6-3.2 ms, 27 at 3.2-6.4, 3 over 6.4, worst 17.7 ms, spread over ~110 frames from frame 7 so about half landed after the key prompt, and the player (blind to arm order) called that capture the worst of the four. One cold sound_object costs 2-18 ms, so a time budget can only decide whether to START another item, never bound the one it starts. v1.1 builds the whole queue synchronously inside actor_on_first_update next to the inventory and encyclopedia prewarm and registers NO actor_on_update listener at all. Everything the first run already settled stays settled: first inventory open 19.6/17.8 -> 5.5/7.2 ms, encyclopedia leave-dialog 8.8/7.7 -> 1.9/1.9 ms, jump/land ~1.1 -> ~0.6 ms, and actor_on_footstep had no call reach the 0.1 ms floor in either variant capture. This is a HITCH comparison, not an fps or ms/frame one: the player drives the workload by hand, so the mean script ms/frame and the fps delta between the arms mean nothing and must not be quoted. SCRIPTED ROUTINE, identical in every capture, exactly as in i058-hitch-request.json and the first I-063 run: do NOTHING until the 30 s warm-up is over and open NOTHING before the capture starts (the first inventory open of the session must land inside the capture); then (1) open the inventory (I), wait ~2 s, close it; repeat 5 times with ~10 s between opens; (2) open the PDA (P), wait ~3 s, close it; twice; (3) jump 10 times, a couple of seconds apart, on the ground you are standing on; (4) walk ~15 s so footsteps fire; (5) talk to an NPC and leave the dialog twice if one is within reach, otherwise skip and say so. Finish ~30 s before the end and stand still. Read it back with: py -3.12 lab/tools/profile_report.py --queue <id> --listeners --hitch --top 400
